title: stevia ovata var. reglensis
intro: Stevia ovata var. reglensis, commonly known as Stevia reglensis, is a plant species within the Stevia genus, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce blood pressure, and aid in weight management, making it a valuable resource for individuals with diabetes and other metabolic disorders. The therapeutic actions of Stevia reglensis are attributed to its ability to inhibit the activity of alpha-glucosidase enzymes, thereby slowing the digestion and absorption of carbohydrates. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include steviol glycosides, kaempferol, and quercetin, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
